# Execution quality – daily TCA
Session = notebook variable `@session` (default `'$yesterday'`; set e.g. `'2026-11-11'` to pin a day). Markouts are in bps of fill price, signed so **positive = market moved in our favour**. Exchange fills are benchmarked against the mid **on the venue they traded on**; broker/OTC trades against the primary exchange.

SELECT h.offset / 1_000_000_000 AS horizon_s,
       t.venue || CASE WHEN t.passive THEN ' passive' ELSE ' aggressive' END AS flow,
       avg(CASE WHEN t.qty > 0 THEN mid(q.bid, q.ask) - t.px ELSE t.px - mid(q.bid, q.ask) END / t.px * 10000) AS markout_bps
FROM energy_fills t
HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND t.venue = q.source)
LIST (-60s, -10s, 0, 1s, 10s, 30s, 60s, 2m, 5m) AS h
WHERE t.ts IN @session
ORDER BY flow, horizon_s
cells.name: Markout curve by venue and flow (bps, + = in our favour)

cells.value:
### How to read it
- **Aggressive** fills should start near **minus the half-spread** and then flatten or recover. **Passive** fills should start near **plus the half-spread**.
- **Getting picked off** shows up as passive fills (or aggressive ones) that keep falling after 0. Look at `decay_0_to_60s_bps` and `t_decay` in the scorecards; |t| < 2 is noise.
- A curve already moving before 0 (negative horizons) means we chase momentum or leak information.
- Big 5m/30m moves that are the same size and opposite sign for buys and sells are **market moves**, not execution. Check the market-move chart before blaming a counterparty or trader.
- Passive fills printed *through* the touch with an old quote are a **stale-benchmark artefact** (illiquid strips), not losses.

WITH x AS (
  SELECT t.venue, t.passive, t.symbol, t.qty, t.px, h.offset / 1_000_000_000 AS hs,
         CASE WHEN t.qty > 0 THEN mid(q.bid, q.ask) - t.px ELSE t.px - mid(q.bid, q.ask) END AS d,
         (q.ask - q.bid) / mid(q.bid, q.ask) * 10000 / 2 AS half_spread
  FROM energy_fills t
  HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND t.venue = q.source)
  LIST (0, 60s, 5m) AS h
  WHERE t.ts IN @session
), u AS (
  SELECT x.*, d / px * 10000 AS bps,
         i.px_factor * CASE i.fx_symbol WHEN 'EURUSD' THEN 1.107 WHEN 'GBPUSD' THEN 1.328 ELSE 1.0 END AS usd
  FROM x JOIN energy_instruments i ON i.symbol = x.symbol
), g AS (
  SELECT venue, passive,
         count() / 3 AS fills,
         sum(CASE WHEN hs = 0 THEN abs(qty) * px * usd END) / 1e6 AS notional_musd,
         avg(CASE WHEN hs = 0 THEN half_spread END) AS half_spread_bps,
         avg(CASE WHEN hs = 0 THEN bps END) AS mk_0,
         avg(CASE WHEN hs = 60 THEN bps END) AS mk_60s,
         stddev_samp(CASE WHEN hs = 60 THEN bps END) AS sd_60s,
         avg(CASE WHEN hs = 300 THEN bps END) AS mk_5m,
         sum(CASE WHEN hs = 0 THEN d * abs(qty) * usd END) AS pnl_usd_0,
         sum(CASE WHEN hs = 300 THEN d * abs(qty) * usd END) AS pnl_usd_5m
  FROM u GROUP BY venue, passive
)
SELECT venue, passive, fills, round(notional_musd, 1) AS notional_musd, round(half_spread_bps, 2) AS half_spread_bps,
       round(mk_0, 2) AS mk_0_bps, round(mk_60s, 2) AS mk_60s_bps, round(mk_5m, 2) AS mk_5m_bps,
       round(mk_60s - mk_0, 2) AS decay_0_to_60s_bps, round((mk_60s - mk_0) / (sd_60s / sqrt(fills)), 1) AS t_decay,
       round(pnl_usd_0) AS pnl_usd_at_fill, round(pnl_usd_5m) AS pnl_usd_5m
FROM g ORDER BY venue, passive
cells.name: Venue scorecard – exchange fills (USD at fixed FX 1.107 EUR / 1.328 GBP)

WITH x AS (
  SELECT t.curve, t.passive, t.symbol, t.qty, t.px, h.offset / 1_000_000_000 AS hs,
         CASE WHEN t.qty > 0 THEN mid(q.bid, q.ask) - t.px ELSE t.px - mid(q.bid, q.ask) END AS d
  FROM energy_fills t
  HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND t.venue = q.source)
  LIST (0, 60s, 5m) AS h
  WHERE t.ts IN @session
), u AS (
  SELECT x.*, d / px * 10000 AS bps,
         i.px_factor * CASE i.fx_symbol WHEN 'EURUSD' THEN 1.107 WHEN 'GBPUSD' THEN 1.328 ELSE 1.0 END AS usd
  FROM x JOIN energy_instruments i ON i.symbol = x.symbol
), g AS (
  SELECT symbol, curve, passive, count() / 3 AS fills,
         avg(CASE WHEN hs = 0 THEN bps END) AS mk_0,
         avg(CASE WHEN hs = 60 THEN bps END) AS mk_60s,
         stddev_samp(CASE WHEN hs = 60 THEN bps END) AS sd_60s,
         avg(CASE WHEN hs = 300 THEN bps END) AS mk_5m,
         sum(CASE WHEN hs = 300 THEN d * abs(qty) * usd END) AS pnl_usd_5m
  FROM u GROUP BY symbol, curve, passive
)
SELECT symbol, curve, passive, fills, round(mk_0, 2) AS mk_0_bps, round(mk_60s, 2) AS mk_60s_bps, round(mk_5m, 2) AS mk_5m_bps,
       round(mk_60s - mk_0, 2) AS decay_60s_bps, round((mk_60s - mk_0) / (sd_60s / sqrt(fills)), 1) AS t_decay, round(pnl_usd_5m) AS pnl_usd_5m
FROM g WHERE fills >= 10 ORDER BY t_decay LIMIT 15
cells.name: Watchlist – symbols whose markout keeps falling after the fill (≥10 fills)

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT * FROM energy_trade_events LATEST ON booked_ts PARTITION BY trade_id
), e AS ((
  SELECT trade_ts, channel, counterparty, regexp_replace(counterparty::varchar, '_[0-9]+$', '') AS cpty_type, symbol, qty, px
  FROM latest WHERE channel != 'EXCH' AND status != 'CANCELLED' AND trade_ts IN @session ORDER BY trade_ts
) timestamp(trade_ts)), x AS (
  SELECT e.cpty_type, h.offset / 1_000_000 AS hs, count() AS n,
         avg(CASE WHEN e.qty > 0 THEN mid(q.bid, q.ask) - e.px ELSE e.px - mid(q.bid, q.ask) END / e.px * 10000) AS mk,
         stddev_samp(CASE WHEN e.qty > 0 THEN mid(q.bid, q.ask) - e.px ELSE e.px - mid(q.bid, q.ask) END / e.px * 10000) AS sd
  FROM e HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (e.symbol = q.symbol AND q.source IN ('CME', 'ICE', 'ICE_ENDEX'))
  LIST (0, 60s, 5m, 30m) AS h
  GROUP BY e.cpty_type, hs
)
SELECT cpty_type, hs AS horizon_s, n AS trades, round(mk, 2) AS markout_bps, round(mk / (sd / sqrt(n)), 1) AS t_stat
FROM x ORDER BY cpty_type, horizon_s
cells.name: Broker/OTC counterparties by type – markout vs primary mid

WITH b AS (
  SELECT ts, curve, avg(close) AS px FROM energy_quotes_1m
  WHERE ts IN @session AND symbol IN ('NBP_Dec-26', 'TTF_Dec-26', 'UKPWR_Dec-26', 'BRENT_Jan-27', 'GASOIL_Dec-26', 'EUA_Dec-26')
  SAMPLE BY 5m
)
SELECT ts, curve, round((px / first_value(px) OVER (PARTITION BY curve ORDER BY ts) - 1) * 100, 2) AS pct_vs_open
FROM b ORDER BY ts
cells.name: Market move – front contracts, % vs session open (5m)

SELECT ts, source, count() AS quotes FROM energy_quotes
WHERE ts IN @session AND source IN ('ICE', 'ICE_ENDEX', 'EEX', 'CME')
SAMPLE BY 1m FILL(0)
cells.name: Quote feed health – quotes per minute by venue

WITH x AS (
  SELECT t.ts, t.symbol, t.venue, t.trader, t.qty, t.px, q.bid, q.ask, q.ts AS quote_ts
  FROM energy_fills t
  HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND t.venue = q.source)
  LIST (0) AS h
  WHERE t.ts IN @session AND t.passive
)
SELECT ts, symbol, venue, trader, qty, px, bid, ask,
       round((ts - quote_ts) / 1e9, 1) AS quote_age_s,
       round((CASE WHEN qty > 0 THEN mid(bid, ask) - px ELSE px - mid(bid, ask) END) / px * 10000, 2) AS apparent_mk_bps
FROM x WHERE (CASE WHEN qty > 0 THEN px - ask ELSE bid - px END) > 1e-9
ORDER BY apparent_mk_bps
cells.name: Benchmark artefacts – passive fills printed through the touch (look at quote age)

cells.value:
SELECT a.booked_ts, a.status, a.reason, a.channel, a.counterparty, a.trader, a.symbol,
       o.qty AS qty_booked, a.qty AS qty_now, o.px AS px_booked, a.px AS px_now, o.book AS book_booked, a.book AS book_now,
       a.trade_ts, datediff('m', a.trade_ts, a.booked_ts) AS minutes_after_trade
FROM energy_trade_events a
JOIN energy_trade_events o ON o.trade_id = a.trade_id AND o.version = 1
WHERE a.trade_ts IN @session AND a.version > 1
ORDER BY a.booked_ts
cells.name: Booking events – amendments and cancellations for session trades
